_purpose: Canonical structural authority for the oc-mirror v2 ImageSetConfiguration document that Airgap Architect generates. Consumed by backend/test/imageset-config-schema.test.js.
_authorityScope: GLOBAL. This schema belongs to oc-mirror v2, NOT to any OpenShift minor. oc-mirror is resolved from clients/ocp/latest, the latest available globally, independent of the target cluster minor (CLAUDE.md 'External tool version policy'). Do NOT copy this file under data/params/<minor>/ — per-minor copies would encode a dependency that does not exist and would reproduce the clone-and-drift pattern that produced 810 stale citations.
_doNotInfer: A key's absence from this file means oc-mirror rejects it, not that it is merely undocumented. oc-mirror decodes with DisallowUnknownFields, so any unlisted key is a hard parse failure.
_relatedBacklog: DOC-166. This file is the first implementation slice: it establishes the global structural authority in a form tests can enforce. The relocation of data/params/4.20/oc-mirror-v2.json into this scope is deliberately NOT done here (see docs/minor-release/4.22/DOC166_OC_MIRROR_V2_AUTHORITY.md).

provenance.method: Every path below was either read from the pinned API source or probed directly with `oc-mirror --v2 -c <file> --dry-run`. Rejected paths carry the verbatim error.

strictDecodingEvidence: internal/pkg/config/load.go calls yaml.UnmarshalStrict and dec.DisallowUnknownFields(). Probing a deliberately bogus top-level key returns: json: unknown field "totallyBogusTopLevelField".

kubeVirtContainer.note: The OCP 4.22 documentation table lists this among the top-level entries. The binary rejects it there. Binary wins mechanically (runbook Rule 2.5); the documentation discrepancy is recorded, not silently resolved.

mirror.operators[].packages[].channels[].note: IncludeConfig is a Go type embedded with json:",inline", never a YAML key. It has never existed as a key in v1alpha1, v1alpha2 or v2alpha1. This was defect FQ-9.

mirror.operators[].targetName.note: Present in v1alpha2 and deprecated there in oc-mirror 4.13; removed entirely from v2alpha1.

mirror.helm.local[].charts.imagePaths.note: charts belongs to Repository, not to a local Chart. A local chart carries imagePaths directly.

mirror.platform.channels[].includeMin.note: No such field. Unlike targetName and includeConfig this is not even a v1 carry-over: it appears in neither v1alpha2 nor v2alpha1. The v2alpha1 ReleaseChannel carries exactly name, type, minVersion, maxVersion, shortestPath and full.

mirror.platform.channels[].includeMax.note: As includeMin. Never emitted by the generator, so catalog-only: no generated artifact was affected.

valueShapeRules.rule: array of OBJECTS each carrying name; an array of bare strings is rejected
valueShapeRules.error: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Mirror.ImageSetConfigurationSpec.mirror.blockedImages of type v2alpha1.BlockedImage
valueShapeRules.note: The OCP 4.22 documentation describes this as 'Array of strings'. The binary disagrees. Binary wins mechanically; discrepancy recorded.

semanticRules.rule: When mirror.platform.channels is non-empty and mirror.platform.architectures is absent, oc-mirror defaults architectures to [amd64].
semanticRules.binaryEvidence: With no architectures the binary requests .../graph?arch=amd64; with architectures [arm64] it requests arch=arm64.
semanticRules.consequence: Omitting architectures for a non-x86_64 target cluster mirrors the WRONG release payload while the configuration still parses cleanly. Architect must emit architectures whenever the Blueprint architecture is known.

semanticRules.rule: A package may filter by package-level minVersion/maxVersion OR by channel-level minVersion/maxVersion, never both.
semanticRules.error: mixing both filtering by minVersion/maxVersion and filtering by channel minVersion/maxVersion is not allowed

semanticRules.rule: Operator minVersion/maxVersion must parse as semantic versions. Partial versions such as 4.22 are coerced and accepted.
Duplicate catalog entries, duplicate package names within a catalog, duplicate channel names within a package, and duplicate release channel names are each rejected.

architectMapping._note: Blueprint target-cluster architecture -> mirror.platform.architectures value. Implemented by normalizeBlueprintArch in backend/src/generate.js, shared with install-config architecture.
